cases.prompt: Our repository tests declare new PostgreSQLContainer("postgres") and the suite started failing after an image refresh, not a code change.
expectations: Identifies the unpinned image as the cause and refuses latest or a bare postgres tag
Pins the production major version with an explicit distribution such as postgres:16-alpine
Explains that alpine and the default distribution share SQL semantics but differ in libc dependent tooling and extension availability
Records the resolved image digest and moves tag bumps into their own change

cases.prompt: Should our Redis test use @ServiceConnection or @DynamicPropertySource?
expectations: States that Spring Boot has no built in Redis ConnectionDetails contributor
Chooses @DynamicPropertySource with a static void method and explicit host and mapped port registration
Warns that a half registered connection silently falls back to a default host
Considers a community Redis module that implements a contributor as the alternative

cases.prompt: Our 12 repository test classes each start their own PostgreSQL container and the merge build takes 22 minutes.
expectations: Quantifies the cost as container start count rather than test count
Moves to one container per JVM with a fresh schema or database per class
Adds ResourceLock plus junit.jupiter.execution.parallel.resources and a bounded parallelism factor
Keeps withReuse for local iteration only and states that CI must not rely on it

cases.prompt: Our reference data script stopped being applied on the second local run after we enabled withReuse(true).
expectations: Explains that withInitScript runs only when the data directory is empty and reuse keeps the volume
Makes the seed idempotent with an upsert or conflict clause
Separates seeding from migration execution and hands migration content to the flyway skill
Confirms CI still starts a fresh container per class or run

cases.prompt: With parallel classes enabled we get an intermittent duplicate key failure in two repository test classes.
expectations: Identifies two classes sharing one container and one schema as the cause
Adds a unique database or schema per class and the matching ResourceLock declaration
Verifies with a serial run that the failure disappears, proving a harness race not a defect
Keeps methods within a class sequential so the shared container state stays predictable

cases.prompt: A developer without Docker cannot run the container suite. Can we just skip those tests?
expectations: Uses disabledWithoutDocker on the shared base so the class skips instead of erroring
Verifies the untagged unit suite still runs locally with mvn test
Warns that the flag can hide a broken remote Docker host in CI and requires checking the log for skips
Refuses to disable the Ryuk resource reaper as a shortcut
